reason: B offers the more material-specific, physically plausible, and falsifiable mechanism by linking measured residual dislocation structures to temperature-dependent hardening and recovery, with in situ lattice-strain/dislocation measurements across defined regimes. It remains imperfect because annealing simultaneously changes dislocations, segregation, grain structure, and putative thermal-mismatch fields, but A is more generic, weakly quantified, relies on largely unrelated-alloy evidence, and assumes slow cooling will reduce heterogeneity and creep without adequately isolating that cause.
